Title: Unsupervised evaluation for out-of-distribution detection
Takeaway: Gscore, an unsupervised indicator, effectively predicts out-of-distribution detection performance without labels, achieving state-of-the-art performance on real-world datasets.
Authors: Yuhang Zhang, Jia-Ni Hu, Dongchao Wen, Weihong Deng

Title: Improved Generalization in Semi-Supervised Learning: A Survey of Theoretical Results
Takeaway: Semi-supervised learning can improve generalization in classification and regression tasks, but its effectiveness depends on the assumptions made and the data distribution.
Journal: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

Title: A survey of uncertainty in deep neural networks
Takeaway: This paper provides a comprehensive overview of uncertainty estimation in neural networks, reviews recent advances, and highlights current challenges and research opportunities, while highlighting potential research opportunities.
Authors: J. Gawlikowski, Cedrique Rovile Njieutcheu Tassi, Mohsin Ali, Jongseo Lee, Matthias Humt, Jianxiang Feng, Anna Kruspe, Rudolph Triebel, P. Jung, R. Roscher, M. Shahzad, Wen Yang, R. Bamler, Xiaoxiang Zhu

Title: Explanation audits reveal silent failures of machine learning models under distribution shift
Takeaway: Confidence-derived scores are effective for pointwise screening, while group-aware explanation audits provide complementary evidence about stable but incorrect feature reliance in machine learning models under distribution shift.
Authors: Faraz Masood, Sehba Masood, Arman Rasool Faridi, Andleeb Zoha, A. Khan, Ali Haider Shamsan

Title: LEAP: Linear equations for classifier accuracy prediction under prior probability shift
Takeaway: This paper proposes a classifier accuracy prediction method for prior probability shift (PPS), which can outperform existing methods when combined with quantification techniques.
Authors: Lorenzo Volpi, Alejandro Moreo, Fabrizio Sebastiani

Title: A Comprehensive Survey on Test-Time Adaptation Under Distribution Shifts
Takeaway: Test-time adaptation (TTA) improves machine learning performance by adapting pre-trained models to unlabeled data during testing, overcoming distribution shifts.
Authors: Jian Liang, R. He, Tien-Ping Tan

Title: EM-AUC: A Novel Algorithm for Evaluating Anomaly Based Network Intrusion Detection Systems
Takeaway: The EM-AUC algorithm effectively evaluates network intrusion detection systems without labels, offering a cost-effective and scalable solution for selecting the most effective models.

Title: Performance Estimation in Binary Classification Using Calibrated Confidence
Takeaway: Confidence-based Performance estimation (CBPE) is a novel method that can estimate any binary classification metric using the confusion matrix, providing strong theoretical guarantees and valid confidence intervals.
Authors: Juhani Kivimäki, Jakub Bialek, W. Kuberski, J. K. Nurminen

Title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
Takeaway: The proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments improves performance drift detection accuracy by up to 22-25% and reduces miss detection rates by 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.
Authors: Deepak Kanneganti, Sajib Mistry, S. Fattah, Erik Elmroth, Aneesh Krishna, Monowar Bhuyan
Journal: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management
